capabilities: Mask the middle of sensitive values in Reading view and Live Preview
Reveal the full value in a tooltip on hover
Copy the full value as plain text without Markdown formatting
Configure prefix length, suffix length and mask character
disambiguation: Not a secret or password manager; it only hides part of the displayed value in notes and does not store or generate secrets.
extras: A large part of the README is release/publishing instructions for the community directory rather than user documentation; a Chinese summary of usage is included at the end.
problem: Notes often contain phone numbers, SDK IDs and API keys in plain sight, and Obsidian offers no way to hide parts of such values while keeping them usable.
summary: Masks the middle of sensitive values written as inline code with an sdk: prefix, showing the full value on hover or copy.
